========================================================================
                     WebP Converter Pro - Quick Start Guide
========================================================================

WebP Converter Pro is a high-performance portable desktop app for Windows.
No installation or administrator privileges are required to run this software.
Supports 100+ formats: SVG, PNG, JPG, HEIC, AVIF, PSD, PDF, Camera RAW, and more!

------------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO RUN THE APPLICATION:
------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. EXTRACT ALL FILES:
   - Right-click the "WebPConverterPro_Portable.zip" file.
   - Select "Extract All..." (or use 7-Zip / WinRAR).
   - Choose a destination folder (e.g., Desktop or Downloads) and click Extract.

2. LAUNCH THE PROGRAM:
   - Open the extracted folder.
   - Double-click on "WebPConverterPro.exe" to start the application.

3. OPTIONAL (QUICK ACCESS):
   - Right-click "WebPConverterPro.exe" and select "Pin to taskbar" or
     "Create shortcut" to launch it quickly anytime.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO CONVERT IMAGES:
------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. ADD IMAGES:
   - Click "Files" to pick images/vectors/RAW photos, "Folder" to select
     an entire folder, or simply Drag & Drop files directly into the app window.

2. SET QUALITY & OUTPUT DESTINATION:
   - Adjust the Quality slider (e.g., 80%) or select Lossless mode.
   - By default, WebP images are saved in the same directory as the source.
     Click "Choose" under Destination Folder to pick a custom output folder.

3. START CONVERSION:
   - Click "Convert" on any specific file or click "Start Conversion"
     to convert all images in batch into WebP format!
